# Server submission

Use this form to request that a server be considered for the loadline
Tier 1 corpus. See `governance/self-submission.md` for what happens after
you submit, and `docs/server-selection.md` for the gates a submission is
checked against.

## Server repo or package

Link to the source repository, or, for a server with no public repo, the
published package (npm, PyPI, container image) or vendor documentation URL.

## Transport

stdio, or remote (Streamable HTTP). If remote, the endpoint URL.

## Auth requirements

What credential the server needs to enumerate its full tool surface: none,
an API key, OAuth, or another scheme.

## Free-tier credential path

How a free-tier, no-cost credential can be obtained to run the enumeration.
If no free-tier path exists, say so.

## Maintainer contact

An email address, GitHub handle, or other reachable contact for the
server's maintainer, for the right-of-reply process described in
`governance/right-of-reply.md`.
